feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Iwasan ang hindi kailangang galaw at suportahan ang braso sa posisyong nakita.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Avoid unnecessary movement and support the injured part in the position found.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag ituwid ang deformity kahit hilingin ng tao. Suportahan ito sa posisyong nakita.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not straighten a deformity, even if the person asks. Support it as found.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag itong masahihin. Suportahan sa posisyon at ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not massage it. Support it in place and arrange prompt assessment.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag gumamit ng improvised na splint na walang padding kung hindi sanay; kailangan pa rin niya ng agarang pagsusuri.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not use an unpadded improvised splint without training; she still needs prompt assessment.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Tingnan ang iba pang agarang problema at ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri. Sanay o lokal na tagubilin ang susundin sa immobilization at paglipat.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Check for other urgent concerns and arrange prompt assessment; trained/local instructions guide immobilization and transfer.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi nagdi-diagnose ang BHW ng pinsala. Ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri.
feedback_by_option.en: A BHW does not diagnose the injury. Arrange prompt assessment.
